english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for confusing or disorienting someone.
Use this when something causes someone to become confused or mystified, including when they confuse themselves.

examples.jyutping: gam3 do1 go3 syun2 zaak6 gaau2 mung2 ngo5 laa3

examples.english: That explanation really did puzzle me.
examples.traditional: 你講到咁複雜，搞懵我喇。
examples.jyutping: nei5 gong2 dou3 gam3 fuk1 zaap6 gaau2 mung2 ngo5 laa3
